# ANALYSIS: SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE5_KEEPER_TOP

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** parameter_analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

This parameter set aims to capture edge on J anchor days by tightening stops and profit targets while using volume confirmation and chandelier profit-lock to manage trades. The hypothesis is that these adjustments improve the edge_capture over baseline by better exploiting the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup on winner days and reducing losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

- Entry: Base shotgun_scalper logic (unspecified in input) with volume ratio threshold ≥1.2 for confirmation.
- Exit: 
  - Take profit at 75% of premium (tp_premium_pct=0.75)
  - Stop loss at 35% of premium (stop_premium_pct=-0.35)
  - Time stop at 12 minutes
  - Chandelier profit-lock arms at 60% of premium (chandelier_arm_pct=0.6), trailing 15% off high-water mark (implied from v15 doctrine).
- Strike selection: OTM-2 (strike_offset=2) relative to ATM.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The backtest appears to use quantities matching J anchor days on winner/loser days (e.g., 6 contracts on 4/29, 20 on 5/01) and undefined quantity on other days. For live deployment, requires $25K+ account to accommodate max qty observed in J anchor days (20 contracts). $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** Backtest covers only 8 trading days (2026-04-29 to 2026-05-15) with 1,199 trades. Highly non-representative sample prone to overfit; J anchor days included but insufficient for regime robustness assessment.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no OOS test performed or reported).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no real-fills validation on top 3 J days or any days).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 2026-05-15 with -$195.45 daily P&L.
   - Max drawdown (approx from daily P&L): ~$195.45 (from peak $1,028.85 on 2026-05-07 to $833.40 on 2026-05-15).
   - Blow-up scenario: String of losing days similar to 5/15 could cause rapid drawdown due to high trade frequency (1,199 trades over 8 days). Edge disappearance would accelerate losses.
6. **Concentration:** top-5 days = 13.9% of P&L (low concentration, edge spread across many days).

## Pre-merge gate

- Stage-1 backtest on full 16-month SPY 5m data to verify per-J-day behavior and edge_capture.
- Walk-forward OOS test (e.g., 2025-Q1 train, 2025-Q2 test) with WF ≥ 0.70.
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) vs. BS-sim, requiring < ±20% P&L difference.
- Gym validator pass for strategy logic (e.g., entry/exit rules, parameter bounds).
- Confirmation that edge_capture ≥ 771 (OP-16 floor) on OOS.

## Confidence

3 / 10 -- Low confidence due to sub-floor edge_capture (506.55 < 771), extremely short/sample-biased backtest, and missing OOS/real-fills validation. The parameter set likely overfits to noise in the 8-day sample.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This analysis does not propose a new candidate; it evaluates an existing keeper from the shotgun_scalper_stage5 grinder. The keeper's edge_capture (506.55) is below the OP-16 floor of 771, so it would not qualify for the leaderboard regardless of other metrics. It conflicts with no current leaderboard candidates (all have edge_capture ≥ 780) but offers no complementary value due to inadequate edge capture. Recommendation: do not promote to leaderboard; requires significant redesign to improve J-day edge capture.
